about.title: Our mission
about.description: Nidal Al-Rouh was born from a lived experience to help people who suffer in silence. We believe that no one should face their mental health challenges alone.
about.meaning: “Nidal Al-Rouh” means “the struggle of the soul” or “the journey of the soul” — acknowledging the inner battle while celebrating the resilience that lives within each of us.
